name: terraform-provider-standards
description: Conventions for building a Terraform provider in Go, adopted by a repository rather than enabled for an account. Covers the terraform-plugin-framework layout, tfplugindocs-generated documentation, MPL-2.0 per-file license headers, and adopting the shared provider CI in flungo/github-workflows — golangci-lint v2 and a GoReleaser dual-registry release. Scoped to what holds for any provider; one provider's own specifics stay in its repository.
